sources.title: Elements of Neuronal Systems
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 1.1
sources.supports: 读取理想脉冲神经元、脉冲列与突触术语；正文不重复旧版中胶质不参与信息处理等过度概括，不把事件模型当所有细胞的描述。

sources.title: Integrate-And-Fire Models
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 1.3
sources.supports: 读取被动RC、时间常数、阈值、复位与恒定输入解。100 MΩ、200 pF及不应期参数为本站设定，发放率解析式自主推导。

sources.title: Limitations of the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Model
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 1.4
sources.supports: 读取适应、反跳、分流与空间结构限制；不将普通LIF宣称为自然产生全部神经元发放型态。

sources.title: A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve
sources.authors: A. L. Hodgkin; A. F. Huxley
sources.publication: The Journal of Physiology, 117(4), 500–544
sources.supports: 读取原始论文开篇与电流/门控数学形式，明确来自鱿鱼巨轴突实验；正文不混合1952电压原点与后世绝对电压参数，不复制原始图或数值。

sources.title: Hodgkin-Huxley Model
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 2.2
sources.supports: 读取电流守恒、m³h与n⁴、门控动力学及单位面积参数。该网页表格采用特定皮层参数，正文不误称为原始鱿鱼参数。

sources.title: Synapses
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 3.1
sources.supports: 读取电导乘驱动力与指数突触核，分清向外/向内电流的符号。本站分流阶跃为被动模型，未模拟动作电位。

sources.title: Compartmental Models
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 3.4
sources.supports: 读取树突空间离散、相邻隔室轴向耦合与参数复杂性；不宣称所有详细模型都必须把活性通道限于胞体。

sources.title: Mean Firing Rate
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 7.2
sources.supports: 读取时间计数、跨重复PSTH、群体平均及Fano因子，分别说明平均方式和窗口。

sources.title: Interval distribution and coefficient of variation
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 7.3
sources.supports: 读取ISI、平均间隔与CV；齐次Poisson的指数间隔和CV=1只按指定模型使用。

sources.title: Likelihood of a spike train
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 9.2
sources.supports: 读取连续时间强度、事件乘积与积分补偿项、离散生存概率；正文明确计数Poisson与0/1事件的区别。

sources.title: Statistical Formulation of Encoding Models
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 10.2
sources.supports: 读取条件分布、最大似然、正则化和历史耦合扩展。带脉冲历史的条件强度模型不称为具有无条件独立增量的Poisson过程。

sources.title: Encoding Models in Systems Neuroscience
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 11.2
sources.supports: 读取LNP、感受野与历史滤波；听觉时频核为原创指定权重，不将负权重等同抑制性突触。

sources.title: Spectral-temporal receptive fields of nonlinear auditory neurons obtained using natural sounds
sources.authors: Frédéric E. Theunissen; Kamal Sen; Allison J. Doupe
sources.publication: The Journal of Neuroscience, 20(6), 2315–2331
sources.supports: 读取原始摘要：鸟类听觉前脑，鸟鸣与随机音点条件下STRF差异及预测；不据摘要复述未核验样本数或把鸟类结果当人类皮层定论。

sources.title: Decoding
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 11.3
sources.supports: 读取编码模型贝叶斯反演、刺激先验与读出条件；两Poisson模型的决策界与准确率为独立教学计算。

sources.title: Rate models
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 15.3
sources.supports: 读取Wilson–Cowan类活动方程、增益与瞬态近似；率模型不自动保持完整脉冲网络的瞬态与稳定性。

sources.title: Phase plane analysis
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 4.3
sources.supports: 读取固定点、零流线、Jacobian及特征值实部判断。正文分别限定局部线性化与非线性全局行为。

sources.title: Models of Hebbian learning
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 19.2
sources.supports: 读取局部共同活动、Oja约束和配对STDP模型；双指数参数为本站设定，未伪装成实验拟合。

sources.title: Synaptic modifications in cultured hippocampal neurons: dependence on spike timing, synaptic strength, and postsynaptic cell type
sources.authors: Guo-qiang Bi; Mu-ming Poo
sources.publication: The Journal of Neuroscience, 18(24), 10464–10472
sources.supports: 读取原始摘要中培养大鼠海马神经元、时序、初始突触强度与靶细胞类型依赖；不把pre-before-post增强宣布为所有突触共同规律。

sources.title: Reward-based learning
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 19.4
sources.supports: 读取行为成功信号、延迟信用分配与资格迹；正文以抽象奖励调节规则解释，不将某个调节变量直接等同所有多巴胺活动。

sources.title: Evaluating Goodness-of-fit
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 10.3
sources.supports: 读取独立测试集、过拟合、脉冲似然、时间重标度与多指标检验。本文留出计数模型只验证指定生成过程。

sources.title: The time-rescaling theorem and its application to neural spike train data analysis
sources.authors: Emery N. Brown; Riccardo Barbieri; Valérie Ventura; Robert E. Kass; Loren M. Frank
sources.publication: Neural Computation, 14(2), 325–346
sources.supports: 核对原始摘要和正式DOI：条件强度积分变换与拟合优度应用；理论细节另据EPFL 10.3，不声称仅凭一张检验图证明模型为真。

sources.title: A Task-Optimized Neural Network Replicates Human Auditory Behavior, Predicts Brain Responses, and Reveals a Cortical Processing Hierarchy
sources.authors: Alexander J.E. Kell; Daniel L.K. Yamins; Erica N. Shook; Sam V. Norman-Haignere; Josh H. McDermott
sources.supports: 2026-10-10：原始摘要：语音/音乐任务优化网络、人类错误与fMRI层级预测；网络层不是解剖脑区等同物。

sources.title: The pairwise phase consistency: a bias-free measure of rhythmic neuronal synchronization.
sources.authors: Vinck M; van Wingerden M; Womelsdorf T; Fries P; Pennartz CM
sources.publication: NeuroImage, 51(1), 112-122
sources.supports: 原始摘要：有限样本偏差、PPC总体对应平方PLV、跨条件试次/事件数问题。本文PPC与R代数关系为从事件对余弦平均展开的教学推导。

sources.title: Physical units
sources.authors: Brian 2 developers
sources.publication: Brian 2 official documentation
sources.supports: 读取物理量、SI前缀及维度不匹配检查；正文NumPy例子使用显式SI转换，未依赖未安装Brian或声称官方示例即本站代码。

sources.title: The Problem of Neural Coding
sources.authors: Wulfram Gerstner; Werner M. Kistler; Richard Naud; Liam Paninski
sources.publication: Neuronal Dynamics, Cambridge University Press / EPFL author-hosted online edition, 7.6
sources.supports: 读取计数、跨重复平均与下游可利用读出的区别；不把实验者能估计的PSTH直接当脑内可用信号。

access_note: Fulltext denotes accessible primary text with relevant sections read; it does not claim every page was read. Existing shared references retain their registry access levels. All charts and model data are original, no external figures republished.
